name: origin-ui-dialog
blurb: Centered modal dialog with fade-in zoom and built-in close button.
description: Radix UI Dialog wrapper with themed styling, overlay fade, and centered zoom animation. Includes composed components for header, title, description, and footer. Fully accessible with keyboard support.
use_when: You need a standard, accessible modal with no custom animations.
avoid_when: You need layout morphing or complex animations — this is CSS-based and fixed position.
a11y: Full Radix Dialog accessibility: Escape closes, focus trap, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation. Built-in close button with visible focus ring.
